function.name: local.run
function.description:
Execute a saved script by filename in absolute cwd. Save with script_patch in an earlier call. Extensions: .sh uses zsh, .py uses python3, .js/.mjs/.cjs use Bun. Optional args are literal strings. Each execution uses a private snapshot unaffected by later patches.
cwd: absolute path from System overview service dataDir (never ~/ shorthand, never the code repo unless the user explicitly asked to run inside that repo).
heartbeatSec: optional positive seconds (e.g. 30). If the process is still running when that time elapses, return immediately with heartbeat=true, status=running, processId, stdoutPreview/stderrPreview — do not wait forever. Then use local.process_status to poll, or local.process_stop to kill. If the process exits before heartbeatSec, you get the normal complete result and the heartbeat ends. No heartbeatSec: wait until completion (optional timeoutMs still kills the group when elapsed).
Complete stdout/stderr persist in stdoutPath/stderrPath. Nonzero exit means failure.

cwd.description: 运行目录的绝对路径。使用 System <overview> 注入的服务数据目录绝对路径（不要用 ~/），不要使用代码仓库路径，避免污染项目。

timeoutMs.description: 可选执行时限（毫秒），省略则不设时限；到期终止进程组

heartbeatSec.description: 可选心跳秒数；进程在该时间后仍在运行则提前返回 heartbeat=true + processId，由模型决定继续查询或停止
